title: Aromatic Thai Cabbage Kanom Ko
description: A sweet and fluffy Thai dish featuring cabbage leaves, served as a solo dinner in a kanom ko form, cooked on a binchotan grill with a nimono simmer method, low in sodium.
instructions: Preheat the binchotan grill to medium heat.
In a blender or food processor, combine coconut milk, palm sugar, fish sauce, and lime juice, and blend until smooth.
In a large pan, heat the vegetable oil over medium heat and saute the garlic and ginger until fragrant.
Add the blended coconut milk mixture to the pan and bring to a simmer.
Reduce the heat to low and add the cabbage leaves to the pan, spooning some of the simmering liquid over them.
Cover the pan and cook for 10 minutes, or until the cabbage leaves are tender.
Stir in the chopped Thai basil and season with salt to taste.
Serve the cabbage leaves in a kanom ko form, garnished with additional Thai basil if desired.
Cook the kanom ko on the preheated binchotan grill for 2 minutes on each side, or until lightly browned.
